title: Ben 2,741, Mack zero sympathy
intro: Ben scored 2,741, the best score any team has posted this season, and beat Mack by 785.5, the biggest margin of the year. Ben is 5-0 and gets 4-1 Sammy next, with a player Sammy let go now in Ben's lineup. Koren finally won, by 519 over Matt G. Wemby scored 176.5 on Saturday, the second biggest game of the season and 1.5 points short of the league's all-time top 10.

teams.Ben: 5-0, the best score of the season, a perfect lineup every day and the most starter games in the league, 48. Jokic was the player of the week with 424.5, including 149.5 on Sunday, and Franz Wagner added 351. Daniss Jenkins, streamed and let go by Sammy last week, scored 220.5 as the waiver hero of the week. Paul Reed also joined Ben, his fourth team in this league this season. Next up is Sammy, the team that gave Ben Jenkins.
teams.Max: The luckiest win of the week. Max scored 2,105.5, seventh in the league, and beat Matt W by 96.5, which makes the series 16-6. Yaxel Lendeborg had 238, Flagg 232 and LaMelo 191.5, and Mo Bamba was streamed for 119. P.J. Washington had 77 in three starts. Koren is next, and Koren won their last meeting by 644.
teams.Matt W: Two losses in a row now, by 96.5 to Max with the eighth best score of the week. Karl-Anthony Towns had 297 and Jeremiah Fears, the Koren castoff, put up 259. Egor Demin sat on the bench for 70.5, the biggest bench blunder of the week, and Fred VanVleet's 71.5 on Friday did not count either. Caleb Wilson started two games and scored zero. Zero moves all week.
teams.Karan: The heartbreaker of the week. Karan scored 2,481, third in the league, and lost to Sean by 236 in their first ever meeting. Jamal Murray had 327.5, Ausar Thompson 275 and Josh Giddey 265.5. Jrue Holiday, dropped by Ben this week, scored 135.5 as a pickup. Matt G is next, and Karan is 2-0 against Matt G all-time.
teams.Sean: Two wins in a row and back to 2-3. Sean scored 2,717, second in the league, and beat Karan by 236. Wemby had 381.5 in three games, including 176.5 on Saturday, the second biggest game of the season behind his own 201. AJ Dybantsa added 291.5. Mikal Bridges had 135 in four games. Next is Mack, a series Sean leads 9-8.
teams.Sammy: 4-1 and the luckiest team in the league by a mile. Sammy beat Dean by 274 with the fourth best score of the week and is 4-1 with only the seventh most points in the league. Brunson had 295 and Bam put up 137.5 on Sunday, Sammy's best single game this season. Tari Eason had 96 in three starts. Next is 5-0 Ben, starting Daniss Jenkins, whom Sammy streamed and dropped last week.
teams.Koren: First win of the season, and it was loud: 519 over Matt G, the third biggest blowout of the year. Anthony Davis had 318, Embiid 296, and Jayson Tatum scored 228.5 that actually counted for once. Tristan da Silva, who gave Sammy zero points last week, scored 142.5 for Koren, and Brayden Burries, cut by Max, added 121.5. A perfect lineup every day. Max is next.
teams.Dean: Three losses in a row. Dean lost to Sammy by 274 with the sixth best score of the week. Desmond Bane had 251 and Harden 238, and the pickups worked: Cam Spencer scored 171.5 and Toumani Camara, cut by Koren in week 3, scored 145.5. Jaime Jaquez Jr. had 77.5 in three starts. Matt W is next, and the series is tied 2-2.
teams.Matt G: Lowest score in the league, 1,885, and a 519-point loss to Koren, who had not won a game until now. Tyler Herro had 148.5 on Saturday, Matt G's best single game this season, but SGA managed 185.5 in three games. Amen Thompson is on bust watch again at 34.8 a game. Nic Claxton, cut by Karan, scored 104 as a pickup. Karan is next, and Matt G is 0-2 against Karan all-time.
teams.Mack: Mack lost to Ben by 785.5, the biggest blowout of the season, and was also on the losing end of the second biggest, 599 in week 1. Duncan Robinson started four games and scored zero points. Donovan Clingan had 273 and Cedric Coward 260. Zero moves for a second straight week. Next is Sean.

preview: Ben, 5-0, plays Sammy, 4-1, for first place, with Ben up 12-8 all-time and Sammy's old streamer Daniss Jenkins now in Ben's lineup. Max gets Koren, who won their last meeting 3,188.5 to 2,544.5. Matt W and Dean are tied 2-2 all-time, and Mack and Sean are about as even as it gets at 8-9.

email.hook: Ben scored 2,741, the best score of the season, and beat Mack by 785.5, the biggest blowout of the year. Ben is 5-0 and plays 4-1 Sammy next.
facts: Mack lost the biggest blowout of the season, 785.5 to Ben, and also the second biggest, 599 to Matt W in week 1.
Paul Reed has played for four different teams in this league this season: Matt G, Dean, Koren and now Ben.
Mack started Duncan Robinson for four games and got zero points.
Sammy is 4-1 with only the 7th most points in the league.
Wemby's 176.5 on Saturday missed the league's all-time top 10 single games by 1.5 points.

bites.Ben: 5-0 after beating Mack by 785.5 points, the biggest blowout of the season.
bites.Max: Won with only the 7th best score in the league, edging Matt W by 96.5 points.
bites.Matt W: Lost to Max by 96.5 points while Egor Demin's 70.5 points sat on the bench.
bites.Karan: Third best score of the week, 2,481 points, and still lost to Sean by 236.
bites.Sean: Second straight win. Wemby scored 176.5 in one game and Sean beat Karan by 236.
bites.Sammy: 4-1 with only the 7th most points in the league. Gets 5-0 Ben next.
bites.Koren: First win of the season, a 519-point beating of Matt G.
bites.Dean: Third loss in a row, by 274 to Sammy, despite 171.5 points from pickup Cam Spencer.
bites.Matt G: Lowest score in the league, 1,885 points, and a 519-point loss to previously winless Koren.
bites.Mack: Lost to Ben by 785.5, the biggest blowout of the season. Duncan Robinson scored zero in four games.

email.teaser: Ben, 5-0, plays Sammy, 4-1, for first place, starting Daniss Jenkins, the player Sammy let go. Max gets Koren, who won their last meeting.

cover.title: THE 785-POINT BEATDOWN
cover.scene: Nikola Jokic, drawn as a giant, flicks a no-look pass over the whole arena to Daniss Jenkins, who dunks it as the scoreboard flashes 785.5. Down below, Duncan Robinson sits alone on a bench with Mack's logo, holding up a sign that says ZERO.
